title: 文法題・第 1 組（依你作文的弱點）

items.stem: When it comes to ____ AI tools at work, many managers remain cautious.
items.explain: When it comes to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。你在作文裡寫成 to use，這是最常考的陷阱之一。

items.stem: Employers value the ability to analyze data and ____ effectively with AI.
items.explain: 平行結構：to analyze ... and (to) work，and 前後要用同樣的形式。

items.stem: The logistics company, ____ provides storage services for major retailers, has expanded rapidly.
items.explain: 逗號後的非限定子句不能用 that；先行詞是公司（物），用 which。

items.stem: Each of the new interns ____ required to complete a safety course.
items.explain: Each of + 複數名詞，主詞是 each，動詞用單數。

items.stem: ____ the system saves time, employees still need to verify its output.
items.explain: 後面是完整子句，要用連接詞 Although；Despite 後接名詞。也注意 although 和 but 不能同時出現。

items.stem: I ____ nearly two hours a day preparing meeting materials.
items.explain: 人當主詞花時間用 spend + 時間 + V-ing；cost 和 take 的主詞通常是事物。

items.stem: Not only ____ faster, but it is also more accurate.
items.explain: Not only 放句首要倒裝：Not only is the tool faster ...

items.stem: Had the company invested earlier, it ____ its competitors.
items.explain: Had + S + p.p. 是省略 if 的過去完成假設，主要子句用 would have + p.p.。

items.stem: The manager insisted that every report ____ checked before submission.
items.explain: insist 表「堅持要求」時，that 子句用原形動詞（省略 should）。

items.stem: ____ by the new regulations, many firms revised their data policies.
items.explain: 公司是「被」法規影響，分詞構句用過去分詞 Affected。

items.stem: She is looking forward to ____ from the admissions committee.
items.explain: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

items.stem: The number of applicants ____ risen sharply this year.
items.explain: The number of 的主詞是 number（單數）；A number of 才接複數動詞。
